image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Nothosaurus mirabilis from the config library at the starting line of the Solnhofen coastal shallows. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Smooth, seal-like skin with a dark navy-blue dorsal pattern and dappled silver-grey spots; long slender neck; prominent interlocking needle-teeth that protrude even with the mouth closed. ACTION: Basking on a sun-drenched ivory limestone rock ledge, one webbed foot dipping into the water, head alert and scanning the shoreline. FACIAL EXPRESSION: Inquisitive and highly alert, with his needle-teeth showing. SETTING: Warm, shallow coastal water with limestone outcrops. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3'. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' front-three-quarter view.
